children: Santa Teresa, New Mexico--(Newsfile Corp. - September 2, 2026) -

("GreenPower"), a leading manufacturer and distributor of all-electric, purpose-built, zero-emission medium and heavy-duty vehicles serving the cargo and delivery market, shuttle and transit space and school bus sector, today announced the delivery of the first tranche of three
to

, an education and child care organization in Sunland Park, New Mexico. The all-electric, purpose-built, zero-emission vehicles will be used for day care transportation and represent the first commercial deliveries of EV Star Passenger Vans in New Mexico.

The delivery advances GreenPower's commitment to expanding safe, sensible and sustainable transportation while giving The Hive a purpose-built, all-electric mobility solution for its daily operations. The EV Star Passenger Van offers seating for up to 19 passengers plus a driver, a range of up to 150 miles and standard AC Lewvel 2 charging and DC fast-charging capability. An ADA-compliant configuration is also available.
GreenPower’s President Brendan Riley conducted training for The Hive CEO Jose Favela and his team in preparation for deployment of the EV Star Passenger Vans for its day care transportation needs.
To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:

"This delivery marks an important first for GreenPower in New Mexico and shows how all-electric vehicles can serve the everyday transportation needs of local business, organizations and commerical entities in the state," said Brendan Riley, President of GreenPower. "We are proud to support The Hive as it introduces a healthier, safer ride for the children and families it serves."

"Reliable, safe and healthy transportation is central to helping children access our programs, and these new zero-emission GreenPower passenger vans will strengthen that service while supporting a cleaner future for our community," said Daisy Lira, Founder and Chief Development & Advocacy Officer of The Hive. "We are excited to work with GreenPower and to put these vehicles into service for our day care transportation needs."

Purpose-built from the ground up as an all-electric vehicle, the EV Star Passenger Van is designed for shuttle, transit and community transportation applications. Its flexible seating configurations, electric passenger door and available accessibility equipment allow operators to tailor the vehicle to specific service needs.

"Deploying GreenPower's EV Star Passenger Van will provide our day care children with cleaner, healthier transportation by eliminating tailpipe emissions during daily trips and reducing their exposure to exhaust around loading areas and neighborhood routes. As a purpose-built, all-electric, zero-emission vehicle, it also offers a quieter ride, helping create a calmer and more comfortable travel experience for young passengers while supporting cleaner air in the communities where they live, learn and play," Lira concluded.
For more information about GreenPower's line of EV Star commercial Class 4 vehicles, contact Nahui Olin at nahui.o@greenpowermotor.com.

About GreenPower Motor Company Inc.

GreenPower designs, builds and distributes a full suite of high-floor and low-floor all-electric medium and heavy-duty vehicles, including transit buses, school buses, shuttles, cargo van and a cab and chassis. GreenPower employs a clean-sheet design to manufacture all-electric vehicles that are purpose built to be battery powered with zero emissions while integrating global suppliers for key components. This OEM platform allows GreenPower to meet the specifications of various operators while providing standard parts for ease of maintenance and accessibility for warranty requirements. For further information, go to www.greenpowermotor.com.
